heading: Initial risk assessment
bodyCopy: Inspection status
Required at London Tilbury
Not required
You must use the correct reference and code on the customs declaration or your consignment will be delayed.
What you need to do
Tell the haulier that this consignment must go directly to London Tilbury when it enters Great Britain.
If the consignment does not arrive in Great Britain at the entry point stated in this notification, it must go directly to the Border Control Post where it first arrives in Great Britain.
Tell the haulier that this consignment does not need an inspection.
Initial risk assessments can change.
What happens next
An inspector may update the risk assessment.
If the risk assessment changes, IPAFFS will notify you and any nominated contacts by text message or email.
Notification submitted
Check GVMS
The Goods Vehicle Movement Service (GVMS) will notify the driver of all entry inspections.
The driver must check GVMS before arriving at the border location to find out if entry inspections are required.
Entry inspection status
Exit inspection status
On entry to Great Britain
On exit from Great Britain
How to view or amend this notification
You can view or amend this notification from your dashboard.

govukComponents.usage: Header banner titled 'Initial risk assessment'. Colour variant switches on risk outcome: --inspection-required (attention) vs --green (success). Only the header/title is used; no banner content.
Confirmation panel repurposed to show 'Inspection status' with the outcome ('Required at London Tilbury' or 'Not required'). Uses only govuk-panel__body; no govuk-panel__title.
Three read-only reference rows (CHED reference, Reference for your customs declaration, Customs document code) each with a Copy action.

'Copy' buttons in each summary-list row action cell, copying the reference value to the clipboard (data-copy-value). In the green variant they carry a 'hidden' class (progressive-enhancement: shown once JS initialises).
govukComponents.evidence: trace 94d29a163f6ab37556cd585b4eabeec9b9c27d84 action 143 (visible); trace 0a6f82fcd63c4cd83fcab91687b522f3f865a74e action 146 (same three buttons carry the hidden class)

govukComponents.usage: Warns: use the correct reference and code on the customs declaration or the consignment will be delayed.
'Initial risk assessments can change.' — shown only in the inspection-not-required (green) variant.
Visible horizontal rule separating the reference panel from the guidance sections.
External feedback link to a Qualtrics survey (opens in new tab).

nonStandardPatterns.whatItDoes: Repurposes the GOV.UK notification banner as a colour-coded 'Initial risk assessment' header. The banner has only a custom __risk-title heading and no body; colour swaps by risk outcome.
nonStandardPatterns.concern: Not a standard notification-banner usage (standard banner has a title 'Important'/'Success' plus content). Custom modifier classes and a bespoke green variant imply custom CSS outside the govuk toolbox.
nonStandardPatterns.govukAlternative: In the rebuild, model the risk-assessment outcome with a standard Panel (green/success for not-required) or a Notification banner with the standard success modifier, plus body copy — rather than an empty header-only banner.

nonStandardPatterns.pattern: panel--inspection-required / panel--inspection-not-required (govuk-panel with only __body, inline style border-top:none)
nonStandardPatterns.whatItDoes: Uses the confirmation Panel to display 'Inspection status' + outcome, with no panel title and a custom border/colour per variant.
nonStandardPatterns.concern: Standard govuk-panel is a large success panel with a title and reference. Here it is restyled (custom modifiers, inline border override) to act as a status tile — bespoke CSS.
nonStandardPatterns.govukAlternative: A standard Panel (title = the status), or Summary list / Tag component to convey inspection status, would keep it inside the toolbox.

nonStandardPatterns.pattern: copy-button (custom class on a govuk-button, data-copy-value, data-prevent-double-click)
nonStandardPatterns.whatItDoes: Clipboard-copy widget: copies the reference/code value client-side. Carries 'hidden' class until JS enhances it.
nonStandardPatterns.concern: Clipboard copy is a bespoke JS behaviour not part of the GOV.UK Design System. Buttons render as govuk-button--secondary but the copy behaviour is custom.
nonStandardPatterns.govukAlternative: No direct Design System equivalent. Keep the govuk-button--secondary styling; the copy-to-clipboard JS is an acceptable progressive enhancement but must degrade gracefully (value already visible in the summary list).

nonStandardPatterns.pattern: link-button (custom class on <a> exit links: 'Return to your dashboard', 'Create a new notification')
nonStandardPatterns.whatItDoes: Styles anchor links as button-like exit actions.
nonStandardPatterns.concern: Custom class rather than a govuk component; mixes link and button semantics.
nonStandardPatterns.govukAlternative: Use govuk-button (with href, rendered as <a>) for the primary 'Return to your dashboard' action and a plain govuk-link for 'Create a new notification', per Design System guidance.

nonStandardPatterns.whatItDoes: Custom feedback block ('Tell us what we can improve') linking to an external Qualtrics survey.
nonStandardPatterns.concern: Bespoke IPAFFS feedback widget/class, not a Design System component.
nonStandardPatterns.govukAlternative: Standard 'phase banner' feedback link, or a plain heading + govuk-link, would replace the custom block.

openQuestions: Legacy source resolves the Check GVMS gap: for CHED-P it uses the heading 'Notification submitted', status 'Check GVMS', body 'The Goods Vehicle Movement Service (GVMS) will notify the driver of all entry inspections.' and inset instruction 'The driver must check GVMS before arriving at the border location to find out if entry inspections are required.' (ipaffs-frontend-notification/service/src/views/importer/common/confirmationCheckGvms.html:11-40; selected at routes/handlers/importer/chedp/confirmation.js:79-82).

Legacy source adds four transit confirmation variants not represented by the two rendered snapshots. All show separate Entry inspection status and Exit inspection status values; the branch is selected from inspectionRequired and sealCheckRequired (ipaffs-frontend-notification/service/src/routes/handlers/importer/chedp/confirmation.js:64-76; views/importer/chedp/confirmationTransitEntryAndExitInspection.html:13-45, confirmationTransitEntryInspection.html:13-42, confirmationTransitExitInspection.html:13-37, confirmationTransitNoInspection.html:21-36). Rebuild policy should confirm whether both status rows remain required display output.

This confirmation page gathers no user input. The three reference display fields are read-only summary-list values (dd elements), recorded so the rebuild preserves the exact reference triplet (CHED reference, customs declaration reference, customs document code N853). It also contains Copy buttons and exit/feedback links.

There is no govuk-heading-xl H1 on this page. The only H1-equivalent is the H2 'Initial risk assessment' (notification-banner__risk-title). The document <title> is 'Import notification sent - Import and export applications - GOV.UK'. Recorded 'Initial risk assessment' as heading; flag for a11y in the rebuild (a confirmation page should have a proper H1).

Two outcome variants confirmed by traces: (a) inspection REQUIRED — banner --inspection-required, panel 'Required at London Tilbury', copy = 'must go directly to London Tilbury' + BCP fallback paragraph; (b) inspection NOT required — banner --green, panel 'Not required', copy = 'does not need an inspection' + inset 'Initial risk assessments can change.' QA adds an inferred third CHED-P outcome, exact status text 'Check GVMS' (tests/notification/ched-p/ched-p-inspection-non-transit.spec.ts:19-27,98-101). The accompanying banner colour and full instructional copy for Check GVMS were not captured and remain a gap.
Copy-to-clipboard buttons are progressive enhancement (marked 'hidden' until JS in the green-variant trace). The reference values are always visible in the summary list regardless.
The feedback link URL uses ched=CVEDP in the Qualtrics query string (legacy 'CVED' naming for CHED-P); recorded verbatim from the trace.

ConfirmationPage recognises exact text 'Go to place of destination' as a fourth risk-assessment state (page-objects/notification/ConfirmationPage.ts:26-28,50-51), but no admissible CHED-P workflow/spec produces or asserts it. Confirm whether this state applies to CHED-P and, if so, its trigger, banner/panel styling and full guidance copy.

The QA reference regex permits a 7- or 8-digit numeric suffix (types/ched-type.ts:17), whereas both traces show 7 digits. Confirm whether the rebuilt service must accept and render legacy/exhausted 8-digit CHED-P references.
